fonte: own taxonomy (Matteo, 2026-10-23), English version; same ids as taxonomia.json
uso: categoria = broad field; genero = subfield; 'general' = the field as a whole

categorias.desc: applied computing: building, using or securing software, hardware, networks and AI (not the basic science behind them)

generos.desc: languages, code, software engineering, architecture, frameworks, git, web and mobile development
AI, machine learning, LLMs, prompts, agents, language models and their applications
information security, pentesting, hacking, privacy, applied cryptography, hardening, CTF
databases, data analysis, SQL, spreadsheets, visualization, data science
operating systems, Linux, networking, servers, cloud, DevOps, system configuration
computers, components, peripherals, electronics, devices, BIOS, physical maintenance
scripts, workflows, integrations, no-code, tools and apps to automate tasks
the note is about technology as a whole, or about a topic that fits none of the subfields above
